title: VooPoo Doric 60 Pro Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Doric 60 Pro Pod Kit is designed for vapers who want a versatile, easy-to-use pod system that doesn’t compromise on power or flavour. Boasting an impressive 2500mAh built-in battery, this sleek, ergonomic and compact kit delivers up to 60W of power, ensuring you have the juice for extended vaping sessions while keeping the device portable and intuitive to use. The PnP X Pod, with a 2ml e-liquid capacity, is easy to refill via the bottom side-filling port, and it’s compatible with Voopoo’s full range of PnP-X coils, offering outstanding versatility and the ability to customize your vaping experience. Whether you prefer a mouth-to-lung (MTL) or direct-to-lung (DTL) draw, the Doric 60 Pro has you covered with adjustable airflow that can be fine-tuned to your preference. The kit includes two coils: PnP-X 0.8ohm coil (best for MTL vaping) Pre-installed PnP-X 0.3ohm coil (best for DTL vaping) The device’s button-activated system allows you to adjust wattage and control firing, while the Type-C fast charging port ensures minimal downtime. Thanks to Voopoo’s GENE chipset, you’ll also benefit from rapid firing speeds, multiple safety protections, and consistently excellent performance. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced vaper, the Voopoo Doric 60 Pro offers a balance of simplicity and power that makes it a fantastic option for everyday vaping. We recommend using the following E-Liquid with this kit Voopoo PnP-X 0.3ohm - Use high VG (sub-ohm) E-Liquids Voopoo PnP-X 0.8ohm - Use 50/50 or Nic salt E-Liquids Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping. How to set up the Voopoo Doric 60 Pro Pod Vape Kit
